threshold_info.risk_high: Model risk at or above this value is shown as high.
threshold_info.risk_moderate: Model risk at or above this value is shown as moderate.
threshold_info.ddcfdna_pct: 1% is the cut-off most often used to separate normal from abnormal dd-cfDNA (e.g. DART). Some centres use 0.5-0.75%.
threshold_info.dsa_mfi: MFI >= 1,400 is the binary DSA cut-off used by the iBox prognostication system. Labs differ.
threshold_info.dsa_rise_pct: Relative rise in the immunodominant DSA MFI versus the previous measurement.
threshold_info.tac_cv_pct: Published cut-offs for high tacrolimus intrapatient variability range roughly 23-40%.
threshold_info.egfr_drop_pct: Relative eGFR decline compared with the value ~3 months earlier.
threshold_info.eplet_class2: Class II (DR+DQ) eplet mismatch >= 14 was associated with more de novo class II DSA (Sakamoto 2020).

model.target: Biopsy-proven TCMR or ABMR within 12 months of the visit
model.data: Fully synthetic cohort generated by cortex/sim.py. No real patient data.
limitations: Performance on synthetic data does not predict performance on real patients.
Requires prospective validation on local, real-world cohorts before any clinical use.
Eplet and PIRCHE-II values are simulated; production use requires HLAMatchmaker / PIRCHE integration.
Not a medical device. Decision support only; the treating clinician decides.
